name: X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: XIAP encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase XIAP. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and cysteine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and DNA damage response.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked lymphoproliferative disease due to XIAP deficiency (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
